title: Ecosystem Integrations
content:
Photon's zero-shim architecture makes it easy to integrate with the broader JavaScript ecosystem. We provide official Orbits for common tasks and patterns for third-party tools.

GraphQL Orbit

@gravito/graphql provides a zero-config GraphQL server powered by Yoga. It mounts directly into your Photon route tree.

import { OrbitGraphQL } from '@gravito/graphql'

const graphQL = new OrbitGraphQL({
  schema: mySchema,
  path: '/graphql'
})

app.orbit(graphQL)

Job Queues

@gravito/stream is our high-performance queue system. It supports Redis, SQS, and Kafka with a unified API.

import { OrbitStream, Job } from '@gravito/stream'

// Initialize the queue
const stream = new OrbitStream({
  default: 'redis',
  connections: {
    redis: { driver: 'redis', host: 'localhost' }
  }
})

class EmailJob extends Job {
  async handle() {
    await sendEmail(this.payload)
  }
}

// Push to queue using the initialized instance
await stream.push(new EmailJob({ to: 'user@example.com' }))

OpenAPI / Swagger

For API documentation, we recommend using @asteasolutions/zod-to-openapi. Since Photon uses standard Zod schemas, you can register them to generate specifications automatically.

import { OpenAPIRegistry } from '@asteasolutions/zod-to-openapi'

const registry = new OpenAPIRegistry()
registry.registerPath({
  method: 'get',
  path: '/users',
  responses: { 200: { description: 'User list' } }
})

Monitoring (Sentry)

You can integrate Sentry using a global middleware that wraps the execution context.

import * as Sentry from '@sentry/bun'

app.use(async (c, next) => {
  try {
    await next()
  } catch (err) {
    Sentry.captureException(err)
    throw err
  }
})
